unadjusted_daily.rule: Never forward-fill an execution price; missing market sessions require dated suspension review.

adjusted_daily.rule: Adjustment direction and corporate-action behavior must match the frozen Baostock adjustflag=2 indicator basis or be declared provider drift.

fundamental_filings.rule: Only pubDate <= signal_date may enter a snapshot; latest restatement published later remains unavailable earlier.

membership.rule: Use no index_weight trade_date after signal_date; audit interim official adjustments.

industry.rule: Baostock historical taxonomy is the formal reference; other taxonomies require explicit drift.

security_state.rule: Exact limits take precedence; heuristic limit fallback must be labeled.

corporate_actions.rule: An empty table cannot be marked audited without a complete source coverage proof.

completion_rule: No table or snapshot is considered complete from API success alone; compare expected dates, members, rows and actions against a dated coverage manifest.
